צו.ja: אעם, ואחסאנה אליה אט'הר, ולזום אלשכר ואלחמד עליה אוכד, והד'א נט'יר קול אלכתאב ואנכי תרגלתי לאפרים קחם על זרועותי ולא ידעו כי רפאתים.
צו.en: And no one of the people of reason doubts that the man's bounty and blessing upon the child were *greater*, and his beneficence to him *more manifest*, and the obligation of thanks and praise for it *more binding* — and this is what Scripture compares to in saying: "I myself taught Ephraim to walk, taking them in my arms; but they did not know that I healed them" (Hosea 11:3).

pairs.en: *greater*
his beneficence to him
*more manifest*
the obligation of thanks and praise for it
*more binding*
this is what Scripture compares to in saying

pairs.ja: ואנכי תרגלתי לאפרים קחם על זרועותי
pairs.en: I myself taught Ephraim to walk, taking them in my arms
but they did not know that I healed them

צו.ja: ואלכ'לה אלת'אלת'ה פי ג'הלהם קדר נעמהֵ אללה עליהם, הו מא יערצ'הם פי אלדניא מן צ'רוב אלאפאת ומא ילחקהם מן צנוף אלג'ואיח פי אבדאנהם ואמואלהם,
צו.en: The third obstacle in their ignorance of the worth of God's blessing upon them is what befalls them in the world from the various kinds of injuries, and the various calamities that overtake them in their bodies and in their property.

pairs.en: The third obstacle
in their ignorance
of the worth of God's blessing upon them
is what befalls them in the world
from the various kinds of injuries
and the various calamities that overtake them
in their bodies and in their property

צו.ja: פג'הלוא אסבאב וג'וה אלנעמה עליהם ומנאפע אלמחנה ואלאדב להם פיהא, נחו קול אלולי ע"ס אשרי הגבר אשר תיסרנו יה ומתורתך תלמדנו.
צו.en: They are ignorant of the causes that lie behind the aspects of the blessing that are in these, and the benefits of trial and discipline for them within them — like the saying of the Friend (peace be upon him): "Happy is the man whom You discipline, O Lord, and out of Your Law do You teach" (Psalms 94:12).

pairs.en: They are ignorant
of the causes that lie behind the aspects of the blessing
and the benefits of trial and discipline for them within them
like the saying of the Friend (peace be upon him)
Happy is the man whom You discipline, O Lord
and out of Your Law do You teach

צו.ja: ונסוא אן הם ואמואלהם נעם כרימה אנעם אללה בהא עליהם ג'ודא ופצ'לא, ת'ם אנפד' פיהם בעדלה מא אוג'בת חכמתה,
צו.en: They forget that they themselves, and their property, are noble blessings God has bestowed upon them out of His generosity and bounty — that He then enacts among them, by His justice, what His wisdom has made obligatory;

pairs.en: They forget
that they themselves, and their property
are noble blessings
God has bestowed upon them
out of His generosity and bounty
that He then enacts among them, by His justice
what His wisdom has made obligatory

צו.ja: פקנטוא ענד אנתשאר עדלה פיהם, ולם יחמדוה ענד אשתהאר פצ'לה ואחסאנה עליהם,
צו.en: so they fall into despair at the going-forth of His justice among them, and they do not praise Him when His bounty and beneficence become manifest upon them.

pairs.en: so they fall into despair
at the going-forth of His justice among them
and they do not praise Him
when His bounty and beneficence become manifest upon them

צו.ja: פחמלהם ג'הלהם עלי ג'חוד אלנעמה ואלמנעם בהא עליהם, ורבמא בלג אלג'הל בכת'יר מנהם אלתעקל עליה פי אפעאלה וצנוף אלכ'לאיק אלתי כ'לקהא למצלחתהם.
צו.en: So their ignorance carries them to denying the blessing and the One who has bestowed it — and in many of them the ignorance reaches so far as railing against Him in His deeds, and in the various creatures He has fashioned for their welfare.

pairs.en: So their ignorance carries them
to denying the blessing
and the One who has bestowed it
and in many of them the ignorance reaches so far
as railing against Him in His deeds
and in the various creatures He has fashioned for their welfare

צו.ja: ומא אשבההם פי ד'לך בעמיאן אדכ'לוא פי דאר מהיאה להם בג'מיע מצאלחהם,
צו.en: How like they are, in this, to a company of blind men brought into a house prepared with everything for their welfare —

pairs.en: How like they are, in this
to a company of blind men
brought into a house
prepared with everything for their welfare

צו.ja: קד וצ'ע כל שי פיהא אחסן וצ'ע ואתקן אחכאם תלקא מנאפעהם וקצד מצלחתהם,
צו.en: every item set in the best position and most perfectly arranged, designed to deliver their benefits and aim at their welfare.

pairs.en: every item set
in the best position
and most perfectly arranged
designed to deliver their benefits
and aim at their welfare

צו.ja: ואסתעד להם פיהא מע ד'לך באכחאל נאפעה ובטביב חאד'ק יעאלג'הם בהא לתצח אבצארהם,
צו.en: Moreover, beneficial collyria were made ready for them in it, and a skilled physician to treat them with these collyria so that their sight might be restored —

pairs.en: Moreover
beneficial collyria were made ready for them in it
and a skilled physician
to treat them with these collyria
so that their sight might be restored

צו.ja: פאגפלוא אלעלאג' להא ולם ילתזמוא אלטאעה לטביבהם אלמתולי לעלאג'הם,
צו.en: yet they were heedless of the treatment, and did not bind themselves to obedience to the physician set in charge of their cure.

pairs.en: yet they were heedless of the treatment
and did not bind themselves to obedience
to the physician
set in charge of their cure

צו.ja: פתרדדוא פי אלדאר והם עלי אסוא חאל מן עמאיהם,
צו.en: So they wandered about in the house, on the worst of conditions on account of their blindness;

pairs.en: So they wandered about in the house
on the worst of conditions
on account of their blindness

צו.ja: פכל מא אכ'ד'וא פי אלמשי פי אלדאר עת'רוא פי אלאסבאב אלמהיאה למצאלחהם ואנכבוא עלי וג'וההם,
צו.en: whenever they set out to walk in the house, they stumbled over the very arrangements set up for their welfare, and pitched forward upon their faces —

pairs.ja: פכל מא אכ'ד'וא פי אלמשי פי אלדאר
pairs.en: whenever they set out to walk in the house
they stumbled over the very arrangements set up for their welfare
and pitched forward upon their faces

צו.ja: פכאן מנהם אלג'ריח ומנהם אלכסיר, פעט'ם שקאוהם ותצ'אעף בלאוהם,
צו.en: some among them wounded, some broken. Great grew their misery, and their affliction redoubled.

pairs.en: some among them wounded
some broken
Great grew their misery
and their affliction redoubled
